The '''Nav Computer Route Astrogation Bypass''' ('''N-CRAB''') was an experimental [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigational computer]] bypass developed by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. It allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to adjust their course while in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] without dropping out of hyperspace first.
